label: Active_gNBs
model_reason: The 'no active gNB found/mismatch of gNBs' error indicates a discrepancy between the Active_gNBs parameter and the actual gNB name used by the DU. Correcting this ensures that the DU correctly identifies itself within the network.
reference_reason: The DU Active_gNBs should match the gNB_name defined in the DU configuration to avoid mismatch errors during initialization.
